summary: Plaintiffs raised fees alongside class relief, and both amounts remained under negotiation before the Whitcombe Reyes settlement. Defense tracked the competing firms’ demands and pursued the lowest-priced prospect while pausing other offers. The transcript does not show a fee-for-relief trade or a misleading declaration.
